fact: President Chakwera launched the Malawi Business Registration System (MBRS) on 29 February 2024, which he said will streamline business registration; online registration is not stated.
Minister of Justice Charles Mhango says the Malawi Business Registration System allows businesses to register and maintain records online, and the registry estimates 20,000 companies register a year.

Malawi Broadcasting Corporation reported on 29 February 2024 that the Ministry of Trade's Malawi Business Registration System (MBRS) was being launched, letting people register a business entity, update information and access certifications digitally.
